_doc: Phase patterns (owner 2026-11-22). Phase per bar from the EMA stack on the stock's own TF; a pattern = 1-3 feature conditions; a 'time' = first bar of a new run of signal bars inside the phase; worked = trade reached +worked_net_pct after costs (target hit before the stop / time exit). Qualifies = its last recent_wins_needed times in that phase all worked -> base confidence; older times in the same phase raise or lower it (ladder, first match wins).

phase.bullish: ema(close, 9) > ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) > ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) > ema(close, 50)
phase.bearish: ema(close, 9) < ema(close, 13) and ema(close, 13) < ema(close, 20) and ema(close, 20) < ema(close, 50)
